title: Provenance
description: CONTRACTS §1.1 — provenance block embedded in every numeric metric/check result (ADR-015). Any computed numeric carries method + method_params; sampled requires seed; approximate requires algorithm; not_computed requires reason and must have no sibling value.

method_params.description: Free-form parameters (sampling_strategy, sample_size, population_size, seed, algorithm, confidence, ...). Conditional rules below enforce required keys per method.

reason.description: Required when method == not_computed (CONTRACTS §1, §1.1). Examples: column_type_unsupported, source_unreadable.

metricValue.title: MetricValue
metricValue.description: Common pairing of a numeric value with its Provenance (used by row_count, missing_rate, distinct_count, min/max/mean/median/p95/stddev, skewness, observed, ...). When provenance.method == not_computed the value MUST be absent (CONTRACTS §1: 'never a silent null').

value.description: Any JSON scalar (number, string, boolean) or bounded structure; omitted when provenance.method == not_computed.

denominator.description: Optional base population for rate metrics (CONTRACTS §3.2 missing_rate).

schemaVersion.title: SchemaVersion
schemaVersion.description: Semver-lite MAJOR.MINOR carried by every persisted object (CONTRACTS §1).
